accessBlock.title: Access to micro-lectures
accessBlock.description: We offer free micro-lectures on Java and soft skills from experienced instructors from leading companies like Apple. Learn from the best and apply your acquired knowledge in real-world projects.

consolidateBlock.title: Consolidate your knowledge in practice
consolidateBlock.description: Our platform offers practical Java exercises with instant automatic result checking. This helps track progress and quickly identify areas requiring improvement.

freeConsBlock.title: Free consultation
freeConsBlock.description: Free personal consultations with our academic advisors will help you define your learning goals, select the right courses, and receive recommendations for successful completion.
